title: EMCOMM incident read-out, version 1
description: What an EOC (Emergency Operations Center) publishes for a voice net to read: counts, unit names and times only. It never carries people's names, phone numbers, email or street addresses, GPS coordinates, injuries or missionary status (owner decision 2026-11-10: those are not read on an open frequency, so they are not in the document at all). A value that could not be computed is null and is spoken as 'not reported', never 'zero'. Producer: church-emcomm-wnlk-forms (eoc/readout.py, GET /api/readout). Consumer: HAM Sidekick Station (repository hamsidekick, station/readout.py).

generated_at.description: When the producer built this document (local time with offset). Not part of the fingerprint.

fingerprint.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of the whole document without generated_at and fingerprint: json.dumps(doc, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False).encode('utf-8'). An approval binds to it.

app.description: church-emcomm-eoc, or manual (typed in at the station)

exercise.description: true = every spoken section begins and ends with 'This is an exercise'

approver.description: Who approves the content before it is read (owner decision 2026-11-10).

role.description: satellite and stake EOCs: Stake President or his delegate; area: Area Authority or his delegate

unit_word.description: what one reporting unit is called at this level

units_expected.description: null when the EOC has not listed its units

needs.description: units (names) asking for each kind of help

notes.description: Short lines the approver typed for the net (shelters open, roads to avoid). Read only after approval.
